message: 軟派男の名は
After going to return last month's milk bottles to old man Amakawa--

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」
Just as I approach the school gate, I bump into a familiar face.

name: Man
message: 「Oh my. If it isn't you, the Student Council President.」

name: Synn
message: 「How do you know I'm the Student Council President?!」
Even a suspicious character like this knows who I am? Guess this is what they call the price of fame.

name: Man
message: 「Because you were being addressed as such the last time we met. Please forgive me if I am mistaken.」

name: Synn
message: 「No, you're not wrong, but...」

name: Man
message: 「And your girlfriend? Is she not with you today?」

name: Synn
message: 「Azelle isn't my girlfriend.」

name: Man
message: 「My apologies. I thought you two made quite the lovely couple.」

name: Synn
message: 「You just came out from inside the academy, didn't you? Outsiders are prohibited from entering. It says so right here.」

name: Man
message: 「It is my creed to prioritize matters concerning ladies above any rule, so I took the liberty of ignoring it.」

name: Synn
message: 「Please don't ignore it.」

name: Man
message: 「I simply wished to express my gratitude and thanks to all the lovely ladies I became acquainted with at the recent event...」
In his hands, he had prepared an assortment of gifts.

name: Man
message: 「However, how tragic. Today of all days, the ladies who ought to be blooming like flowers refuse to show themselves. Might I ask you to enlighten me if you happen to know the reason?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ryuusei Academy became an all-boys school last week.」

name: Man
message: 「W-What a tragedy! Is there no God in this world?!」
The pretentious man staggers, scattering his assortment of gifts across the road.
I hurriedly gather up the scattered gifts and hand them back to him,

name: Synn
message: 「I'm sorry! That was just a joke!」

name: Man
message: 「Haha. Is that so!」
Talk about a fast recovery!

name: Man
message: 「So that is why no one is here save for the lady in the library.」

name: Synn
message: 「The lady in the library?」

name: Man
message: 「A breathtaking woman. Earnest and quite guarded--at a glance, a seemingly impregnable lady, yet...」
Poor Melilot.

name: Man
message: 「Actually, my seventh sense tells me that when she lets her guard down, she is quite the adorable person」

name: Synn
message: 「Anyway, please stop loitering around the campus」

name: Man
message: 「I shall handle the matter appropriately, taking into consideration the circumstance that errands concerning ladies take priority over all else」

name: Synn
message: 「Sigh...」
This guy is hopeless.

name: Man
message: 「Excuse me, Student Council President. If you don't mind, I would love to hear your esteemed name」

name: Synn
message: 「...I'm Synn Sakura」

name: Man
message: 「Synn Sakura! How sweet! What a bittersweet, heart-rending ring it has! Synn Sakura! Oh, Synn Sakura!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahem. What is your name?」

name: Melphas
message: 「Forgive me. My name is Melphas」

name: Synn
message: 「Melphas...」
It has a mysterious ring to it.

name: Melphas
message: 「Pleased to make your acquaintance」

name: Synn
message: 「That's an unusual-sounding name. Where are you from?」

name: Melphas
message: 「The gentleman the Student Council President has brought along with him will know」

name: Synn
message: 「Him...? Whaaat!?」
Paqy?

name: Melphas
message: 「Well then, until fate brings us together again. Farewell!」
Suddenly, a massive flurry of rose petals swirled wildly through the air, and the man slipped away amidst them.

name: Synn
message: 「Ptui, ptui...」
I got petals in my mouth.

name: Paqy
message: 「...That guy's a demon」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaaat」

name: Paqy
message: 「And a pretty strong one, too. Demon General level」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaaaat!? He's not just some playboy?」

name: Paqy
message: 「He's a playboy, sure, but no ordinary one. Going by the ping on my Great Sage antenna, he might even be stronger than Lord Ode」

name: Synn
message: 「I didn't feel a thing...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Once someone's that big a deal, hiding their magical presence is a piece of cake. Still, they can't fool the eyes of the Great Sage」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, it looked like he noticed you too, Paqy」

name: Paqy
message: 「Cocky bastard」

name: Synn
message: 「Then, the fact that I'm the Demon Lord too...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Don't know if he figured out that much, but you'd better assume he realized you're no ordinary human, Demon Lord」

name: Synn
message: 「...Isn't that bad?」

name: Paqy
message: 「He probably noticed back at KiraFes. So there's no point making a fuss about it now. You're the Demon Lord, so act a little more unshakable」

name: Synn
message: 「Why didn't you tell me the other day?」

name: Paqy
message: 「If word got out that a Demon General-level Demon showed up, it would've meant deploying the Crusaders, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Of course it would... ah」
I see, Paqy was being considerate.
If they had deployed, the commotion wouldn't have ended at just that level.
If that had happened, there's no telling what would have become of KiraFes either.
Besides... if Shio-chan's words are right, Melphas suppressed his immense power even when attacked, continuing to act solely as a playboy.
He probably didn't want to cause any more trouble than that either.

name: Synn
message: 「Thanks, Paqy」

name: Paqy
message: 「It's not like I have any reason to be thanked by you, Demon Lord. I just thought it'd be a pain」

name: Paqy
message: 「Things are already enough of a pain as it is」
